# R4.7d — Verification reference-corpus AC fixture halves (DF-S1.21-2 hermetic remainder)

Spec: `docs/tickets/156d_R4.7d__verification-reference-corpus-acs.md` (seq
156d). Depends on R4.7c (stacked; base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.7c` @
`2e774dd`). Requirement ids: **DF-S1.21-2** (the named residual — dated
progress append on the row; the live judge-consumption member stays
R4.7e's) · **BL-05** (the standing gate-accepted battery set the DF rides
on) · **R-2.7.1** · **R-2.7.2a** · **R-2.7.3** · **ADR-0287**.

## Summary

- **`crates/hh-verification/tests/fixtures/refcorpus/`** (new, 8 corpus
  files, 5,261 lines — excluded from the size budget as fixtures) — the
  committed reference corpus: `detection_cells.json` (D2 `phantom_effect` /
  D3 `unverified_verification` / D5 `contract_gap` / D6
  `open_effect_at_completion` + 8 negative-strata cells + a merged-run
  claim), `gate_cells.json` (completion refusal strata, kill/resume
  re-entry, detachable-annotation, abandon → success-with-veto, holds-cap
  exhaustion, honest failure), `metric_cells.json` (subject-verdict
  headline-independence, oracle_failure denominator exclusion,
  `succeeded_unverified` terminality, FCR veto, followed-share two
  profiles), `hosted_cells.json` (hosted end-state gate + `n/a` classes
  by observability/detector), `evidence_cells.json` (pin/tamper, held_out
  deliver rows, admission modes, bundle-freeze), `critic_cells.json`
  (declarations, uncited findings, consume/misuse, comparative orders,
  panel withholding, probe/isolation, taint, agreement counts),
  `calibration_cells.json` (status folds over context changes), and
  `run_500.json` (a recorded 500-event ledger run for rebuild-equality).
- **`crates/hh-verification/tests/r4_7d.rs`** (new, 1,661 lines) — 24
  `ac_r_2_7_*` tests, one per listed AC (AC-R-2.7.1-{5–10},
  AC-R-2.7.2a-{2–8}, AC-R-2.7.3-{2–12}), each driving the public
  verification APIs (`bind_claim` / `reconcile_ledger_only` /
  `evaluate_gate` / `evaluate_gate_hosted` / `pin_check` / `admit_items` /
  `declare_critic` / `consume` / `judge_comparative` / `panel_reduce` /
  `calibration_status_at` / `verdict_taint` / `pi_admission` /
  `check_critic_isolation` / `na_classes` / `compute` / `na_observability`
  / `events::*`) over corpus cells — the fixture halves DF-S1.21-2 names.
  Hermetic: no live judge plumbing, no new dependencies.
- **`crates/hh-telemetry/tests/r4_7d.rs`** (new, 113 lines) — the
  AC-R-2.7.3-10 lowering half: the canonical emitted
  `verification.validator.verdict` payload lowers to
  `gen_ai.evaluation.result` and the loss report names judge identity /
  evidence / calibration / independence / cost.
- **`crates/hh-verification/src/evalfold.rs`** (+6/−3) — two production
  fixes the corpus surfaced that the inline unit tests had missed:
  `divergence_profile` now reads the canonical `divergence_class` payload
  member (it read `class`, silently degrading every real profile to
  `{unknown: 1.0}`); the `visible_pass_rate` denominator excludes
  non-`decided` verdicts (AC-R-2.7.1-8's "oracle_failure … counted
  beside", never a fabricated fail).

## AC → test map

The full enumeration lives in `docs/build/runs/R4.7d.md` — all 24 listed
ACs covered-by executable tests (none missing):

- `AC-R-2.7.1-{5–10}` → `ac_r_2_7_1_{5..10}_*` — held-out leak
  refusal + zero-leak corpus, tamper-arm `EvidenceTampered` +
  success-with-veto, completion gate strata + `succeeded_unverified`,
  headline-independence + `reward_hacking_gap` + oracle_failure
  exclusion, followed detectors per profile + `n/a{no_detector}`, hosted
  end-state verdict parity + `n/a{observability}`.
- `AC-R-2.7.2a-{2–8}` → `ac_r_2_7_2a_{2..8}_*` — the D2/D3/D5/D6
  detection corpus (one `diverge{class}`, deterministic detector,
  resolvable evidence_refs, register severity) + merged-run `agree`, the
  negative corpus at 0 FP, kill/resume gate re-entry + once-per-record
  notices, holds-cap exhaustion + honest-failure strata, judged/annotated
  never-hold admissibility, hosted `n/a{observability}` vs FCR
  end-state, 500-event `ledger_only` rebuild equality + instrument cost.
- `AC-R-2.7.3-{2–12}` → `ac_r_2_7_3_{2..12}_*` (+ the telemetry lowering
  half) — uncited-finding drop/count, independence declarations (same_snapshot
  refused; weaker axis recorded; gate calibration), probe refusals
  recorded + spawn isolation + frozen bundle, consume misuse +
  `JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact`, comparative two-order aggregate, panel
  withholding + `oracle_failure` class, calibration status folds,
  agreement-count rates, emitted verdict payload + `gen_ai.evaluation.result`
  lowering + named loss classes, admission omission + quarantine relabel +
  taint + Π raise-only, judged classes `n/a{observability}` by ABI.
